claims_boundary: Custody-side post-quantum readiness is tracked separately from blockchain consensus and transaction-authorization readiness. Production transport security, key wrapping, exposure scoring, or simulated PQ signing do not imply that supported blockchains accept post-quantum transaction signatures.

entities.name: BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association

entities.note: BitGo has deployed Bitcoin quantum-risk scoring/remediation and separately demonstrated ML-DSA-based PQ-MPC signing in a regulated-custody simulation. The public evidence does not establish production live-chain PQ transaction signing across supported blockchains.
